name: octaweave_search
description: Full-text search over the workspace's notes, posts, and kanban cards. Returns {items}. Prefer this over listing a module and filtering yourself. Narrow with `type` when you know which of the three you want. NOTE: calendar events and drive files are NOT indexed — use octaweave_list_events and octaweave_list_folder for those; an empty result here does not mean they do not exist.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

type.description: Optional: note | post | card. Omit to search all three.
